svg.title: Deprotected tetrathiol zinc porphyrin derived from 9 reference
svg.desc: Deprotected tetrathiol zinc porphyrin derived from 9: chemical identity only. Four terminal SH functions after the source deprotection; sensitive to oxidative disulfide formation. No unmeasured solution association assigned. Complete atomic geometry and solution speciation are not assigned.
